_doc: What the game already owns, written once for every feature: read by `converter convert`. A source concept named here is never translated; the game's owner is called. Each entry says why the two are the same concept. | road-elevation: the converter's library plus the game's names of the road tuning (tools/ports/road-elevation).

m.reason: m(x) is x metres in world units; the 4.0 has METERS_PER_UNIT = 1 and the game's unit is the metre

roadStructure.reason: world/structures.ts ROAD_STRUCTURES and roadStructure are the game's structure_spec (sim/roads/road_grade.h): one owner of a structure's clearance, deck and supports, read from the tuning; RoadStructure 'ground' | 'elevated' | 'bridge' | 'tunnel' is Structure 0..3 in that order

Heap.type: std::priority_queue<std::tuple<$real, uint32_t, int>, std::vector<std::tuple<$real, uint32_t, int>>, std::greater<>>

members.pop: [&] { const int top = std::get<2>($self.top()); $self.pop(); return top; }()

Heap.reason: core/heap.ts orders by key, then by arrival: a min priority_queue of (key, arrival, item) is the same order; core/job_pool.h uses std::priority_queue too

patterns.reason: the 4.0 packs a cell's two integers into one key; the game's owner of cell keys is core/grid.h cell_key
